Collection & delivery

A Sauchiehall Street Institution

On Glasgow's famous Sauchiehall Street, Royal Spice Tandoori has built its name the slow way — marinades that rest overnight, sauces that simmer for hours, and breads baked to order in a clay oven. Whether it is a quiet curry for two or a family feast, every dish is prepared with the same care we would give a guest at our own table.
